newsitem.title: USA: Rubbermaid unit sues Fisher Price - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Rubbermaid unit sues Fisher Price - WSJ.

text.p: Rubbermaid Inc's Little Tikes Co unit is suing Mattel Inc's Fisher-Price unit in an attempt to block it from hiring two former executives, the Wall Street Journal reported.
The two executives are Kevin Aker, formerly Little Tikes' vice president of product development, and Kevin Curran, formerly its marketing vice president, the paper said in its electronic edition.
Little Tikes filed the suit in the Court of Common Pleas in Summitt County, Ohio -- its home office.

It alleges that both executives have intimate knowledge of the company's product-development plans and strategies and that Fisher-Price is raiding Little Tikes' executive ranks, according to the paper.
An official from Mattel declined to comment on the matter, the paper said.
The case is the latest example of companies becoming more aggressive in their efforts to keep employees from defecting with sensitive information, the paper added.
